national_news.title: India Dispatches Humanitarian Relief and Rescue Teams to Flood-Hit Nepal
bullets: India dispatched its third flight carrying 10 tonnes of Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief (HADR) supplies to flood-affected Nepal, bringing total relief material sent to over 57 tonnes.
The relief package includes portable generator sets, water purification tablets, food packets, dignity kits, along with an 11-member team of medical professionals and tunnel rescue specialists.
The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) offered Bailey bridges with technical teams for connectivity restoration and rescued 63 Indian nationals stranded at the Trishuli-1 Hydropower Project.

national_news.title: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) Marks 12 Years of Financial Inclusion
bullets: Launched on August 28, 2014, PMJDY has facilitated over 59 crore bank accounts with cumulative deposits reaching ₹3.17 lakh crore and an average deposit of ₹5,356 per account.
Demographic coverage highlights that 78% of accounts are located in rural or semi-urban areas, approximately 56% are owned by women, and over 41 crore RuPay debit cards have been issued.
Supported by the Jan-Dhan-Aadhaar-Mobile (JAM) trinity, India's Financial Inclusion Index (FI-Index) expanded from 53.9 in 2018 to 67.

national_news.title: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman Begins 6-Day Official Visit to the United States
bullets: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman is undertaking a six-day official visit to the United States, covering key cities including Chicago, Asheville, and New York.
She will lead the Indian delegation at the G20 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting under the US G20 Presidency in Asheville.

The visit includes high-level engagements with corporate CEOs, a visit to the Polsky Center for Entrepreneurship at the University of Chicago, and participating in the NASDAQ bell-ringing ceremony in New York.

national_news.title: Severe Flash Floods Triggered by Avalanche Hit Nepal Border Region
bullets: Massive flash floods struck Nepal after an avalanche blocked the flow of the Lhende tributary of the Bhotekoshi River near the China-Nepal border at Rasuwagadhi.
The floods severely impacted multiple districts including Chitwan, Nawalparasi, Dhading, Gorkha, Rasuwa, Nuwakot, and Tanahun, resulting in over 350 deaths.
Over 1,300 people were reported missing across Nepal and Tibet, including 285 Indian tourists, triggering large-scale rescue operations.

bihar_news.title: Karbigahiya-Mithapur Flyover Phase-I and Mithapur-Sipara Elevated Road Inaugurated in Patna
bullets: Inaugurated the first phase of the Karbigahiya-Mithapur flyover and the 2.1-km Mithapur-Sipara elevated road in Patna to reduce traffic congestion near Patna Railway Station.
The Karbigahiya-Mithapur flyover project, including approach and service roads connecting Mithapur Bus Stand to Mithapur Roundabout, was constructed at a cost of Rs 249 crore.
The 2.1-km elevated road section from Mithapur to Sipara has been developed under the broader Mithapur-Mahuli-Punpun connectivity initiative.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Establish JEEViKA-Sudha Sales Centres Across All 8,053 Panchayats
bullets: Under the 'Saat Nischay-3' initiative, Bihar will establish JEEViKA-Sudha sales centres across all 8,053 panchayats to strengthen rural milk businesses and support women-led livelihoods.
Selected 'Sudha Sakhis' will receive dairy storage equipment and training under the Prime Minister's Internship Scheme, supported by COMFED's primary milk producers' cooperative network.

The plan also includes setting up 534 block-level animal medicine sales centres and establishing the Mithila Handicrafts Cooperative Society to export local handicrafts to Cambodia's Angkor Wat region.

bihar_news.title: Parliamentary Standing Committee Reviews Bihar's Transport, Tourism, and Heritage Infrastructure
bullets: The Parliamentary Standing Committee on Transport, Tourism and Culture, chaired by MP Sanjay Jha, conducted a three-day review of Bihar's air connectivity, road network, and heritage sites.
Key infrastructure corridors reviewed included the Patna–Purnia route, Gorakhpur–Siliguri link, condition of NH-27, and planned airport expansion projects announced in the Union Budget.
The delegation assessed preservation efforts at major heritage and pilgrimage centres including Kumrahar, Khuda Bakhsh Library, Bihar Museum, Bodh Gaya, Rajgir, and Nalanda.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Launches Sugarcane Mechanisation Scheme 2026-27
bullets: Bihar Sugarcane Industries Department invites applications via the Cane Care and SUMEK portals to provide subsidies on 44 types of sugarcane agricultural machinery.
General category farmers receive up to 40% subsidy, whereas SC, ST, and EBC farmers receive an additional 10% (taking total support up to 50%).
Crop-residue management equipment attracts up to 75% subsidy (80% for SC/ST/EBC), and machinery banks set up by farmer groups get up to 80% project funding capped at Rs 8 lakh.

bihar_news.title: Bihar and UP Deploy Emergency Rescue Teams Amid Nepal Flash Floods
bullets: Bihar deployed 9 National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) teams with 4 standby teams following flash floods caused by torrential rains in Nepal.
Chief Minister Samrat Chaudhary conducted an aerial survey of the Valmikinagar Gandak Barrage and reviewed emergency measures in Bagaha, Bettiah, and Motihari.
East Central Railway issued an emergency alert in the Samastipur Railway Division while UP deployed 32 SDRF and 22 PAC personnel to assist in relief operations.

bihar_news.title: Defence Minister Lays Foundation for ₹472-Crore T-Series Tank Overhaul Facility at Jabalpur
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh laid the foundation stone for a ₹472-crore facility to overhaul T-72 and T-90 battle tanks at the Vehicle Factory Jabalpur (VFJ).
The project aims to meet the Indian Army's annual maintenance requirements indigenously while integrating local MSMEs into the defence manufacturing supply chain.
The facility complements the Heavy Vehicles Factory at Avadi, Tamil Nadu, which has supplied around 4,400 tanks to the Indian Army over the last four decades.

bihar_news.title: Hydrological and Sedimentation Challenges of Bihar's Kosi River Highlighted
bullets: Severe flash floods at the Nepal-Tibet border renewed flood risk concerns across northern Bihar, particularly in the Kosi River basin.
The Kosi River (Saptakoshi) is formed by the confluence of the Sun Koshi, Arun Koshi, and Tamur Koshi at Triveni in Nepal before flowing into Bihar.
According to ICIMOD, the Kosi carries nearly 100 million tonnes of sediment annually at Chatara, causing frequent riverbed elevation changes and course avulsion.

bihar_news.title: Farakka Barrage Gates Opened Amid Rising Ganga Water Levels in Bihar
bullets: The gates of the Farakka Barrage in West Bengal were opened following a request from the Bihar government after the Ganga river exceeded danger levels across multiple upstream districts.

The Farakka Barrage feeder canal, which has a capacity of carrying nearly 40,000 cusecs, regulates the flow of the Ganga into the Bhagirathi-Hooghly river system to support Kolkata Port navigation and control salinity.
The situation underscores the necessity of integrated river basin management to balance upstream flood mitigation in Bihar with downstream ecological and urban infrastructure impacts in West Bengal.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Establish Women-Only University and Roll Out Women-Centric Welfare Initiatives
bullets: Bihar announced plans to establish a 'Mahila Vishwavidyalaya', an all-women university where students, faculty, vice-chancellor, and staff will exclusively be women.
Disbursed ₹600 crore via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) under the Mukhyamantri Mahila Rojgar Yojana and distributed loans to 10,000 beneficiaries from the JEEViKA Fund.

Set a target to install solar panels at the homes of 10 lakh JEEViKA Didis by March 31 and introduced the Chief Minister Balika PhD Fellowship providing ₹10,000 per month for four years to 1,000 female research scholars.
